origin.human_role: Source of intention, physical reality, operator judgment and action.
origin.ai_role: Generator, critic and architect of hypotheses and falsifiable experiment structure.
origin.generation_condition: Derived from project constraints before any dedicated prior-art search for this hypothesis and before implementation code.

mission_alignment.english: JANUS I0 develops auditable measurement and control methods for reducing unnecessary Proof-of-Work computation, thermal stress, energy waste, and hardware wear while preserving standard SHA-256 verification and valid proof semantics.
mission_alignment.russian: JANUS I0 разрабатывает проверяемые методы измерения и управления, направленные на сокращение ненужных PoW-вычислений, тепловой нагрузки, расхода энергии и износа оборудования без изменения стандартной проверки SHA-256 и правил валидного доказательства работы.
mission_alignment.canonical_line_english: We do not seek to make the machine work faster at any cost. We seek to remove work it should never have had to perform.
mission_alignment.canonical_line_russian: Мы не стремимся заставить машину работать быстрее любой ценой. Мы стремимся убрать работу, которую ей никогда не следовало выполнять.

fundamental_barrier.question: How can JANUS prove that computation was causally unnecessary and preventable, rather than merely unsuccessful in hindsight?
fundamental_barrier.russian_question: Как доказать, что работа действительно была причинно ненужной и могла быть предотвращена, а не просто не принесла результата задним числом?

distinction.not_unnecessary_by_itself: A non-winning SHA-256 attempt is not unnecessary merely because it did not produce a valid proof; before execution it retained the same proof semantics as any other attempt.
causally_unnecessary_after: an authoritative new job invalidates the old epoch
the old epoch is explicitly revoked
the useful target has already been reached
the result can no longer be accepted by the active verifier context

fundamental_barrier.research_object: Limit the amount of work that can simultaneously lie inside the causal cone of becoming stale after an authoritative horizon.

physical_process: Admitted work commits processor time and transistor switching.
Computation consumes electrical energy and releases heat.
Work creates queue, process, ledger and completion obligations.
Cancellation and quiescence have non-zero latency.
During quiescence, some already committed work may remain physically unavoidable.

measurable_quantities.R_t: Current exact-exposure rate, such as hashes per second.
measurable_quantities.X_t: Exact exposure of admitted but not authoritatively resolved work.
measurable_quantities.tau_q_p: Chosen p-quantile of measured quiesce latency.
measurable_quantities.W_H: Exact old-epoch exposure irreversibly executed or finalized after authoritative horizon H.
measurable_quantities.U: Useful valid-epoch work that remained eligible under unchanged verifier semantics.

useful_work_definition: belongs to the authoritative active epoch at the relevant point
preserves nonce traversal and candidate semantics
could produce a standard valid result
first_principles.causality_rule: A computation becomes causally stale only after an evidenced authoritative horizon makes its result ineligible or no longer useful under the frozen semantics.
correlation_is_not_causation: lower temperature alone does not prove less unnecessary work
lower power alone does not prove preserved useful output
lower work count alone may reflect changed concurrency, difficulty, scheduling or workload
only matched control and intervention with frozen semantics can support a causal claim

candidate_hypotheses.name: Unresolved Exposure Cap
candidate_hypotheses.mechanism: Maintain X(t) <= B, where B is a fixed cap on admitted but unresolved exact exposure.
candidate_hypotheses.possible_new_element: Express the cap in exact computational exposure rather than task count, process count or queue depth.
candidate_hypotheses.prediction: Maximum stale tail decreases as B decreases, until control overhead or blocked useful work dominates.
candidate_hypotheses.not_equivalent_to: Not clock throttling; full compute speed may remain unchanged while outstanding causal obligations are bounded.
candidate_hypotheses.falsifier: No stale-tail reduction, disproportionate useful-work loss, or overhead greater than prevented work.
candidate_hypotheses.self_deception_risk: Relabeling ordinary queue-depth reduction as a new physical effect.

candidate_hypotheses.name: Epoch-Bound Continuation Lease
candidate_hypotheses.mechanism: Every cohort receives a short-lived control-sidecar lease bound to cycle_id, epoch, maximum exposure, expiry and renewal sequence.
candidate_hypotheses.possible_new_element: Treat continued computation as a causal permission that must remain valid for the authoritative epoch.
candidate_hypotheses.prediction: Shorter leases reduce maximum stale tail but create a measurable overhead trade-off curve.
candidate_hypotheses.not_equivalent_to: The mechanism does not select better hashes or reorder nonces; it validates the right to continue.
candidate_hypotheses.falsifier: Lease revocation is not faster than the existing gate, loses eligible results, or destabilizes the runtime.
candidate_hypotheses.self_deception_risk: Allowing the sidecar to become an unacknowledged scheduler.

candidate_hypotheses.name: Causal Irreversibility Budget
candidate_hypotheses.mechanism: Bound the causal waste cone C(t) = X(t) + R_max(t) * tau_q,p + epsilon by a declared budget B.
candidate_hypotheses.possible_new_element: Control an upper bound on causally vulnerable work rather than throughput, temperature or task count.
candidate_hypotheses.prediction: Under valid assumptions, stale exact exposure after an authoritative horizon satisfies W_H <= B with confidence level p.
candidate_hypotheses.not_equivalent_to: Batch size and worker count may remain frozen; the controlled quantity is total unresolved exposure plus physically unavoidable quiesce work.
candidate_hypotheses.falsifier: Any verified W_H > B + epsilon with intact authoritative ledgers and satisfied assumptions.
candidate_hypotheses.self_deception_risk: A hidden queue or biased R_max/tau estimate causes systematic undercounting.

candidate_hypotheses.name: Causal Completion Envelope
candidate_hypotheses.mechanism: Admit a cohort only if its p-quantile completion bound fits before lease expiry minus quiesce latency.
candidate_hypotheses.possible_new_element: Use causal reachability of an eligible completion rather than probability of a favorable proof.
candidate_hypotheses.prediction: Late admissions near explicit lease expiry disappear while work inside the envelope remains eligible.
candidate_hypotheses.not_equivalent_to: Not post-hoc stopping; it limits admissions using an explicit authoritative lease boundary.
candidate_hypotheses.falsifier: Completion latency cannot be bounded or useful work is blocked beyond the predeclared margin.
candidate_hypotheses.self_deception_risk: Choosing an optimistic latency quantile after seeing outcomes.

candidate_hypotheses.name: Thermal Refractory Valley
candidate_hypotheses.mechanism: Use a short post-horizon refractory valley derived from measured thermal time constants before opening the next epoch.
candidate_hypotheses.possible_new_element: Place recovery only at already-authoritative causal boundaries instead of continuously throttling.
candidate_hypotheses.prediction: At matched useful output, thermal-burden and fan-integral metrics decrease.
candidate_hypotheses.not_equivalent_to: Not permanent throttling; it is event-bound recovery.
candidate_hypotheses.falsifier: No thermal-burden benefit, increased wall energy, or mere temporal displacement of heat.
candidate_hypotheses.self_deception_risk: Confusing lower temperature with lower total energy.

selection.selected: Causal Irreversibility Budget with Epoch-Bound Continuation Leases
reason: direct bridge from causal boundary control to preventable work

rejected_for_first_experiment.Thermal Refractory Valley: Requires external wall-power evidence before a strong claim.
rejected_for_first_experiment.Causal Completion Envelope: Depends on a robust completion-latency model not yet established.
rejected_for_first_experiment.Unresolved Exposure Cap: Useful baseline but too close to simple queue limiting on its own.

formal_hypothesis.IF: Each computational cohort is bound to an authoritative epoch lease, and the system knows exact unresolved exposure X(t), a safe upper exposure rate R_max, a verified p-quantile quiesce latency tau_q,p, and a declared accounting margin epsilon.
formal_hypothesis.UNDER: Unchanged SHA-256, verifier, nonce traversal, candidate semantics, scheduler, allocator, concurrency, worker count, batch size, pool configuration, credentials and hardware settings.
formal_hypothesis.THEN: Maintaining X(t) + R_max * tau_q,p + epsilon <= B will bound stale exact exposure after any authoritative horizon by B at confidence level p and will reduce mean stale tail relative to continuous unbounded admission.
formal_hypothesis.BECAUSE: No horizon can make stale more than the already unresolved exposure plus the physically unavoidable work produced during the bounded quiesce interval, assuming complete authority and no hidden queue.
formal_hypothesis.UNLESS: A hidden queue exists, quiesce latency lacks a stable upper quantile, the horizon is incorrectly defined, lease overhead exceeds prevented work, or budget B blocks a materially significant fraction of useful work.

mathematical_contract.non_claim: This model does not predict valid hashes and does not classify pre-horizon non-winning attempts as unnecessary.

known_principles: computation consumes energy and creates heat
authoritative invalidation can make old-epoch results stale
a non-winning pre-horizon attempt was not necessarily unnecessary
derived_inferences: maximum stale tail depends on unresolved exposure and quiesce latency
quiesce latency creates a physically unavoidable lower tail component
the controllable object is a causal cone of vulnerable work
the cone can be expressed in exact-exposure units
new_assumptions: the causal waste cone can be bounded without materially reducing useful throughput
epoch-bound leases can enforce the budget without changing proof semantics
a useful operating region for B exists above the unavoidable quiesce floor
verified_project_facts: JANUS has demonstrated native wave segmentation at A18.42
JANUS can distinguish admission and submission events
JANUS has implemented fail-closed evidence handling
V0.2.7 coherent-cut architecture passed offline validation but is not treated here as a live proof
unverified_predictions: the declared stale-tail bound will hold in deterministic replay
useful exposure loss will stay within the non-inferiority margin
wall-energy benefit may or may not follow and requires a separate experiment

minimal_falsifiable_experiment.purpose: Test whether stale work can be bounded before any energy or hardware-lifetime claim.

intervention.mechanism: epoch-bound continuation leases plus C(t) <= B

primary_metric.name: W_H
primary_metric.definition: Exact old-epoch exposure finalized or irreversibly executed after authoritative horizon H.

minimal_falsifiable_experiment.safety_bound: For every horizon, W_H_intervention <= B + epsilon.

negative_controls.name: SHAM_LEASE
negative_controls.condition: Sidecar and ledger instrumentation run but budget does not restrict admissions.

negative_controls.name: INFINITE_BUDGET
negative_controls.expected: Mathematically and operationally degenerates to control.

negative_controls.name: SHIFTED_HORIZONS
negative_controls.condition: Recorded horizon timestamps are shifted by a predeclared offset.
negative_controls.expected: The effect follows the causal horizon schedule rather than incidental load structure.

negative_controls.name: IMPOSSIBLE_BUDGET
negative_controls.expected: Fail closed because the requested bound is below the measured physical quiesce floor.

sample_plan.exclusions: No outcome may be removed merely because it is unfavorable.

pass_criteria: median stale-tail reduction is at least 30 percent
lower bound of the 95 percent paired bootstrap interval for reduction is greater than 15 percent
useful valid-epoch exposure loss is no more than 1 percent versus control
sham lease is practically equivalent to control
infinite-budget mode is practically equivalent to control
fail_criteria: any verified W_H_intervention > B + epsilon with intact authoritative ledgers
useful exposure loss greater than 1 percent
sham lease shows the same effect as intervention
the budget can only be met by changing frozen semantics or hardware settings
evidence_insufficient_criteria: quiesce latency too unstable to estimate tau_q,p
control and intervention receive different workload traces
replay is not representative enough of the live runtime

claim_boundaries.eligible_after_offline_pass: A deterministic replay may support a claim that stale work was bounded and reduced under the sealed model and trace.
not_eligible: novelty or absence of prior art
